snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter the fray, protect the Imperial Forge world and experience the events that cemented Captain Titus’ place in the history of the Ultramarines. For the Emperor.   

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition is the definitive edition of Captain Titus and the Ultramarines’ fight against the Ork Hordes, updated for a new generation with 4K resolution, modernised controls, an interface overhaul, improved character models and remastered audio. Experience this landmark third-person shooter set within the grim darkness and ceaseless conflict of the Warhammer 40,000 universe like never before. 

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine Master Crafted Edition releases June 10th on PC, Game Pass and Xbox Series X|S

https://www.sega.com/
